digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: The bridge lacks a store-level mapping of tracker projects to repos, causing project subset diffs to be misinterpreted as remote deletions across repos sharing a snapshot.
Implement a new projects_store.py module to manage .bridge_state/projects.json with version and legacy_default fields, where the projects key set defines the sync list.
Surface the mapping through CLI verb bridge projects (list/set/remove), library function resolve_project(ticket, mapping), and MCP tools (list as read-only, set/remove as write tools).
resolve_project must implement a tri-state rule: absent ticket field returns legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None, explicit key returns the key, and None legacy_default yields None.
Absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default; malformed record raises an error.
set requires --repos argument; set --repos "" stores empty list; set on existing key replaces repos list idempotently without merging.
